minimum_cost_basis.reason: every individually essential cell is in EVERY sufficient basis, so there is no cheaper alternative set to choose

prerequisite_structure.reading: a tree's (p) leaves may only cite cells proved earlier in the same file, so certifying a set costs its prerequisite closure, not just the set

failure_sensitivity.tested: smallest upward error in the claimed upper bound that reopens at least one census row, found by binary search (bounds are monotone in the value)
failure_sensitivity.reading: a single-route capacity value would have to be wrong by this much BEFORE any census row reopens; +1 opens nothing anywhere
